title: GPU Management: Why Idle GPUs Are the New Grounded Aircraft
summary: 文章将闲置GPU比作停飞飞机，强调GPU管理的重要性，指出当前数据中心GPU利用率低下的问题，并探讨了通过调度、虚拟化和监控等手段提升GPU利用率的策略。
highlights: Idle GPUs are the new grounded aircraft, representing massive sunk costs and missed opportunities.
Effective GPU management can boost utilization from 20% to over 80%, significantly reducing total cost of ownership.
Key strategies include workload scheduling, GPU sharing, and real-time monitoring to eliminate idle time.
